**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/21 (Sun) 18:29
- [FACT] The user is creating sculptures and has completed a small clay bird project in their sculpting class.
- [PREFERENCE] The user is proud of their clay bird project and is considering selling their sculptures online.
- [EVENT] The user is thinking of selling their sculptures online and is seeking help with pricing strategies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on completing their clay bird project and offered to help with pricing strategies for selling sculptures online.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided factors to consider when pricing sculptures, including materials and production costs, time and skill, size and complexity, uniqueness and originality, market demand, target audience, brand and reputation, and pricing psychology.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested pricing strategies such as cost-plus pricing, value-based pricing, competitive pricing, tiered pricing, limited edition pricing, and discounts and promotions.

- [PREFERENCE] The user is considering starting with a lower price point of around $75 for their clay bird sculpture.

- [PREFERENCE] The user is thinking of offering a bundle deal for their art fair next month, including a set of three small sculptures at a discounted price.
